summary.text: Zac Ista is a Democratic member of the North Dakota House of Representatives representing District 43 (Grand Forks), serving since 2020 and as House Minority Leader. His standing committees in the 2025 regular session are Finance and Taxation.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Ista is an attorney with a BA in secondary education and social science from NDSU and a JD from American University's Washington College of Law.
He serves on the interim Budget Section and Legislative Management, and is vice chair of the interim Legislative Procedure and Arrangements Committee.
His biography lists him as married to Leah, with two children.
